notes.title: Sker Ritual Episode Three: Sewers of the Dead OUT NOW
notes.content:
The wait is over Sker Islanders, Sker Ritual's Episode Three: Sewers of the Dead is OUT NOW! Descend into the Sewers of the Dead, the Sker Island underground lair and home of The Stranger! 

EXPLORE THE BRAND-NEW MAP 

Delve into the Sewers of the Dead, the Sker Island underground lair and home of The Stranger. Navigate through tunnels of infestation where the Quiet Ones are not your only enemy. Watch where you step as The Stranger's swarm of rats are under the control of his glaring eyes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/eb32dc057ea32a87d3f235e93cb30d05ce5fedae.gif

 FACE CHALLENGING NEW ENEMIES 

GUTO (Elite Enemy #1)

Run, run as fast as you can because in a flash the Guto will be upon you. These agile elites dash at alarming speed and in unpredictable directions, making every twist and turn through the dank underground a possible threat.  

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/63ad69d7bdb815c0ae68fadb41af040279ba7603.gif

DEMON HAG (Elite Enemy #2) 

Now she’s here...now she’s not...beware the teleporting Demon Hag and her searing laser beams that shoot out from her gruesome, green eyes. Rising from the dirt and murk, this elite is a deadly combination of the Witch and the Mariner.  

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/6d659aa250634524057866a24780296ef4242a9b.gif

NEW OBJECTIVES 

Unlock areas of the map with the help of a mind-controlled Quiet One. Escort the lumbering enemy turned ally safely and be sure to keep feeding it points if you want it to walk faster.  Plus, send Quiet Ones into a spin! Set in the gory, gorged-out chests of Quiet Ones, shoot the rat in the hamster wheel to get them going.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/2b6baa6c6afef9a444c8e3a11a2342b262c1840b.gif
 
NEW WEAPONS 

THE PLAGUE - Special Weapon 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/f21092ab2a13f7cc2c96186a62bce8333a7aafaf.gif

The Plague, Sker Ritual’s answer to Pest Control. Discharge bombs with this multi-grenade launcher that releases plumes of purple gas. Damage enemies and objects alike to progress your objectives.  

CROSSBOW 

Load up! This crossbow shoots a fan of 3 arrows and will slaughter through 3 enemies in turn. The crossbow will also be available in all levels. 

PIONEER’S AXE 

This infamously powerful melee weapon possesses a radius slash damage to hack through multiple targets. The Pioneer’s Axe will also be available in all levels. 

BEAT THE NEW BOSS 

Find yourself transported into the warped mind of The Stranger. Avoid the sight of his relentless scanning eyes, but don’t get caught or be prepared to face swarms of rodents whilst still combatting waves of Quiet Ones. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/fa2b2de0900f86083bb1703865da5fd0cd6b7d65.gif

NEW FIXES AND UPDATES 

 25 new, free Sker Pass rewards 
 New Achievements  
 New achievement icons 
 Localisation for Episode 2 & Episode 3 
 Updated Aim down Sight position for The Howler 

UPCOMING FOR EPISODE 3 

 Name of the level and difficulty in the end screen and scoreboard screen  
 Notification when you kill a main boss 
 Possibly adding weapon stats when buying in-game. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/74292309910fbb3947731c0a63b6d6c4fea5966d.jpg

Experience Sker Ritual's Episode Three: Sewers of the Dead with our amazing Discord community. Let us know your initial reactions, feedback and form new Sker Squads to take on the Quiet Ones together. 

Stay tuned for information on our upcoming updates, patches as well as additional DLC & bundled content!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33855640/761da51b304833990a67437f833f0bbb2d54cba6.gif

We can finally reveal the timed exclusive demo for Sker Ritual in the Steam Next Fest event which runs in tandem with Geoff Keighley’s Summer Game Fest from June 13th-20th! The demo will enable 1-4 players to team up online and face Sker Island’s Quiet Ones and their more powerful cohabitants, The Elites, in a first-person round-based survival shooter.

After customising their character’s horror-themed masks, players can jump into Solo, Private or Quick Play online matchmaking for one map, The Cursed Lands of Lavernock. The demo will include a sample of our Story Objectives and gain full access to The Laughing Policeman’s shop and the steampunk-inspired Magnificent Munitions Upgrade Station.

The demo represents the end of Alpha development and will switch to Beta before launching on Steam Early Access later this Summer. The alpha demo will be limited to 30 minutes per game, with an unlimited amount of replays. We’re excited to listen to the community’s feedback and encourage all players to join the Sker Ritual Discord server to be a part of the journey and connect with others in the community.

notes.title: Sker Ritual FAQ
notes.content:
WELCOME TO THE OFFICIAL SKER RITUAL FAQ! 

If you have any questions you’d like to see added, we’d love to hear it! Please leave a comment here (or reach us on Twitter, Reddit) for the developers to curate and answer. 

We will be updating the FAQ as we continue to develop the game, answering more questions while also updating ones we’ve answered previously. You will find more detailed information about the game in our weekly Developer Updates! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/a08102c818b17199dd2a65325824f2b1b8494381.gif

What is Sker Ritual? 

Sker Ritual is the spiritual successor to our award-winning, single-player horror game, Maid of Sker. Inspired by the Maid of Sker Challenge mode, we wanted to allow our players to play with friends online, and explore what we could achieve in an online co-op multiplayer. 

What type of gameplay can we expect? 

Sker Ritual is a co-op wave shooter first and foremost but it will feature in-game challenges, tasks, and some soon-to-be-revealed events, which will reward you with story content (as well as unlockable content). The choice is yours, play solo if you're brave enough or grab up to 4 players to tackle the onslaught of Quiet men together. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/19dcebef2773a4a5d9fb599533ea82d7d9e38a98.gif

What time period is this game going to be set in? 

Set shortly after the events of Maid of Sker, Sker Ritual takes place in the early-1900s with a little more of a steampunk influence. There is action, adventure, survival horror, mystery, and a little gothic science fiction. Sker Hotel has moved on a little since you last saw it, it's now in the 20th Century and has a few surprises still to come. 

Why Wales? 

As a team of Welsh developers (some are adopted), we believe there is a rich talent pool, history, and mythology available in Wales that deserves to be discovered. For those across the pond who may not know, although we are joined with England by land, and we are part of Great Britain, Wales is a country in its own right. Not to be confused with the Australian state New South Wales, Wales is the one with the dragon on the flag! 

Will there be a beta? 

Yes! We hope to bring you a beta phase opportunity soon. Our development team are working tirelessly to bring you the smoothest multiplayer experience. We strongly recommend subscribing to our newsletters, forums and socials to ensure you don't miss out on an exclusive beta opportunity. See below for all our sign-up links. 

What weapons are going to be in Sker Ritual?  

Those following our Developer Updates get a sneak peek into The Laughing Policeman's Magnificent Munitions shop where base weapons can be bought at high-risk locations. The real fun comes with the unique weapon upgrades at The Laughing Policeman's Super Charger (remember we mentioned our Steampunk influence?). We’ve barely scratched the surface here, we have so much more to reveal soon! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/be339f1995c1508d0418a12847c625438d392166.gif

What maps are included?	 

We're bringing you “The Cursed Lands of Lavernock”, get to know it better in our series of updates where we highlighted the abandoned Cathedral, the underground living quarters, the ancient farmland and — a mysterious looking chamber? Stay tuned in and subscribe to the Sker Ritual Steam Community for updates on what's next for the locations in Sker Ritual. 

Who are the enemies? 

The Quiet Ones have returned, only now they seem a little more... undead. Maid of Sker fans might also recognise a new and improved Blazeslinger, Banshee, Mariner and Phantom in the Developer Update #2. These juggernauts are tough to take down and each have a unique set of abilities that will force you to change-up your playstyle, change your location, or enlist the help of your teammates! Old enemies aren't the only ones to curse the lands of Sker, we have many more new faces — even some without faces — to show you. 

When is the release? Will there be pre-order? How much will it cost? 

The release details will be confirmed in due time, please follow, Wishlist and join our newsletter to be first to know.

notes.title: Sneak Peek #3 - Weapons and Upgrades
notes.content:
ROLL UP! ROLL UP! 

GET YOUR MAGNIFICENT MUNITIONS AT THE LAUGHING POLICEMAN! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/0475358b4e3e71aafba3e6afdd43562b21cf866b.gif

Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the show!

Introducing the maniacal, the mechanical, the malevolent, The Magnificent Munitions at The Laughing Policeman!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/c391298bde0c127dd36dc188af39c912ff376f85.jpg

Get your guns, ammo, and more at The Laughing Policeman’s booth at various locations in the world. 

The Laughing Policemen has an arsenal filled with weapons of the highest calibre perfect for battling your way through the Quiet Ones with or without your friends.  

Some of the base weapons at The Laughing Policeman’s Magnificent Munitions include a wide variety of weapons, including assault rifles, single or double-barrel shotguns, pistols and revolvers, hunting rifles and more! Choose wisely you can only hold two weapons at a time! 

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/3a0fef4d2e0ac6c11da4fe4f2169d8d3b605f9b6.jpg

Short on ammo? Stock up at his Ammo Blammo machines and never get caught short between the waves of Quiet Ones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/8a41c1109b53476f3017756b4d4587e77ed70d13.jpg

Be sure to be on the lookout for The Laughing Policeman’s Super Charger, but remember it’s location, there’s only one in "The Cursed Lands of Lavernock". At The Laughing Policeman’s Super Charger, you can upgrade any weapon in your inventory, but for a price...  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/2667ca2d4ce7e678860dc4675cd5538f47fa5e7b.jpg

A dev team favourite weapon is the double-barrelled shotgun, it’s great for getting up close and personal with the Quiet Ones and causing an absolute bloodbath. Just a regular old shotgun? Well yes, until it meets The Laughing Policeman’s Super Charger! You’ll be able to upgrade your favourite as long as you can pay the fee...  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/91eca44e1a4650748c3ab04a86fdf55adac5d26b.jpg

Each upgrade gives the shotgun that extra oomph with enhanced properties with a particular playstyle in-mind which is needed when you get further into the onslaught of waves or the show will end mid-act.

notes.title: Developer Update #2 - The Cursed Lands of Lavernock
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

It’s time for a sneak preview and we want to share with you “The Cursed Lands of Lavernock”. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/aac07f45fbad1b8034370bd728315d648dff5e93.jpg

In "The Cursed Lands of Lavernock", players will be exploring a new area of Sker Island taking on waves of the "Quiet Ones". From a small fishing village to a secret underground Laboratory, players will have to use their wits to survive the onslaught and complete their mission across an abandoned Cathedral and areas reminiscent of Sker Hotel. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/876063abca41f4b9c4532a603bb15c021339332c.jpg
The long since Abandoned Cathedral now lays host to ritualistic effigies, with plenty of hidden passages for the Quiet Ones to hunt from 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/8e57247076e7f064d51997a5e0e95a105da8621e.jpg
The Underground Living Quarters holds many secrets, twisting and turning, with areas easily overwhelmed if you’re not careful 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/b3d8bb80cc664e07223e4c7c53ccedddf8075a4c.jpg
The Ancient Farmland is the perfect place for a respite, or an ambush, watch out for the remains of the Quiet Ones previous victims, you can’t save them now 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/687576a7afdbf6ce62240e05d8b27bea6f61d226.jpg
The Mysterious Chamber holds the unknown behind its doors, only the brave can discover 

In Sker Ritual, players will come up against the turned residents of Sker Island. These new "Quiet Ones" pose no real threat to the players but make sure to keep their numbers low or otherwise they will overwhelm you and cause a lot of trouble. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/d58aeb82887af27bea705c5b8210f9281e9d44de.gif

But be careful some are bigger and badder than ever! The Blazeslinger, Banshee, Mariner, and Phantom are familiar faces and if you’ve played Maid of Sker Challenge mode, you know not to get too close and personal to these elite Quiet Ones. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/312bc2a93c23c753b29eb02a890758ef4d44b585.jpg

The Blazeslinger is a little hot-headed, capable of fire attacks at range, but the enemy of my enemy is my friend, wear him down and he might be your best friend. 

Disorientating with her sonic screams The Banshee has the ability to seemingly appear out of thin air, right behind you. 

Lost to the depths The Mariner, somehow now returned and vengeful, his helmet is his power with laser precision you need to stay out of his line of “sight”  

Evening the playing field, he can’t see you and you can’t see him, The Phantom aim carefully or you might just miss him but he will find you.

notes.title: Developer Update #1 - All about Sker
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Welcome back to the world of Sker!

Thank you for joining us in our series of developer updates, explaining more about Sker Ritual and answering even more of your questions. We are a team of 12 Welsh developers, the same team that maid– sorry, made –Maid of Sker. Despite our small size we’re always scouting the forums (and Twitter) and do read all of your questions and comments, so we’d like to try and answer these right now and in the following developer updates.

To co-op or not
With Sker Ritual we aim to bring you and your friends together in an online co-op shooter that leads on from the story of Maid of Sker. You can still tackle the onslaught and discover the story alone, just in case you’re not feeling very social [we get that] but it’s most enjoyed playing with up to a 4-strong team, whether they be friends or future-friends from online matchmaking. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33855640/ff3c6bbb8c411937b4fdd8d781bee087b5923fc0.gif

Continuing the Sker
Sker Ritual does have some familiar faces and a story that leads on from Maid of Sker (more about that soon!) but it is not Maid of Sker 2. Sker Ritual has so many new and familiar faces. We love the characters we created in Maid of Sker and wanted to see how far we could push character creation from a multiplayer perspective within what is already a sker-y world.

SO, WEN GAME??
The game is based after the events of Maid of Sker, in the Victorian era but with a little more of a steampunk influence that was touched on in the single-player horror. Make no mistake this is a wave shooter with a well-written story campaign built-in. Expect close-up action, dark adventure, zombie-esque survival, lots of customization, and some gothic science fiction for good measure. Sker Hotel has moved on a little since you last saw it, it's now in the 20th Century and has a few surprises still to come.

We are working hard to bring you an exciting, high-quality, multiplayer experience and we can’t wait to connect with new and existing fans. Stay tuned for dev update 'dwy' (two) coming soon.

notes.title: Entrancing Songs From Welsh Folklore
notes.content:
🧠 The Mind behind the Music - Interview with Sound Director and Composer Gareth Lumb (if it makes a noise, it was him)

"I would call the music setup in Maid of Sker “pseudo-dynamic”. I try to keep the score fairly dynamic so that it mirrors what’s going on during gameplay. It’s so important for the music to respond sympathetically to gameplay cues."

Find out more in his interview with Rely on Horror:

notes.title: Make Your Reservation at Sker Hotel on July 28
notes.content:
Make your Reservation at the Sker Hotel! 

 Join us for the hotel's Grand Re-opening on July 28th, pre-order from July 21st on PC, PS4 and Xbox One. 

At Sker Hotel we offer grotesque views, eerie forest trails, and blood-soaked beds. Be our guest but watch your step, make a sound and the Quiet Ones welcome you.

[previewyoutube=Ewkx5eBlOEs;full]https://youtu.be/yiC7Z7Ih27I [/previewyoutube]

Now you've seen sound devices in use, you've seen the breathing mechanic, the sound-based AI enemies, the inventory system... now we'd like to share a few details on the save system (a common question we receive!)

Yes, you can manually save your game via our Phonographs.

We welcome you to indulge in the use of the Phonographs, a device for the mechanical recording and reproduction of sound. Invented by Thomas Edison, the American inventor who gave us the Electric light bulb, it transitioned into the gramophone, which led to what we still use today — the vinyl record player.

Our Phonographs offer safety, allowing you to catch your breath and save your game, listen to the recordings and unlock the mysteries lurking within the Sker Hotel. 

Upgrade your stay by adding the game to your Steam Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/826940

Now the gates are opening, we will see you soon.
